summary.intent: Execute Phase 27 (writable-shares-poc) to implement write-enabled folder sharing, including API backend, owner UI, and recipient UI with full CRUD capabilities.
summary.outcome: Phase 27 executed and verified end-to-end with several UAT-discovered bugs fixed: per-file IPNS record creation for shared uploads, dual-key wrapping so both owner and recipient can edit files, shared file save path in TextEditorDialog, and owner edit re-wrapping share_keys for recipients. E2E tests written to cover all new flows.

repo: The ci-debug checkout did not have .env files — they must be copied from the canonical cipher-box repo at ../cipher-box/
SDK packages (core, sdk-core, sdk) must be built before the web dev server can start — web dev server fails with unresolved @cipherbox/sdk without prior build
The web app falls back to window.location.origin + '/api' when VITE_API_URL is unset, causing connection failures when API is on a different port (3000 vs 5173)
NestJS watch mode does not always pick up DTO changes — @ApiProperty enum decorators must be updated alongside the validation decorator for OpenAPI spec to regenerate correctly
The addShareKeys endpoint was owner-only; write-share recipients need permission to add keys to their own share to support file uploads
Owner file update flow (useFileOperations.handleUpdateFile) did not re-wrap the new file key for share recipients — pre-existing gap exposed by writable shares UAT
Permission downgrade clears encryptedIpnsKey on the Share entity but does not touch share_keys table entries

code.finding: Shared upload set fileMetaIpnsName: '' — no per-file IPNS record was created, making uploaded files unretrievable
Save handler used owner's useFolder updateFile path, throwing 'Parent folder not found' for shared files — needed onSaveSharedFile callback prop
Shared file load threw 'IPNS name not available (legacy v1 file?)' when fileMetaIpnsName was empty string
keyType enum was 'file' | 'folder' only — needed 'file-ipns' type to store recipient-wrapped IPNS private key separately from file key
handleUpdateFile did not call reWrapForRecipients after updating file content — recipients lost access after owner edited a shared file
ShareKeyResponse type did not include 'file-ipns' in keyType union, causing TS cast issues when fetching IPNS keys from share_keys
Share entity has recipientId and permission fields; permission downgrade sets encryptedIpnsKey to null but leaves share_keys intact

workflow: Background tasks spawned via Bash tool get killed when conversation context shifts — use detached processes (nohup/disown) for dev servers that must survive across tool calls
NestJS OpenAPI spec only reflects DTO changes after a full server restart with the updated compiled code — tsc watch alone is insufficient
API client regeneration must happen against a running API server with updated OpenAPI spec; regenerating against stale spec produces stale enum types

For dual-key encryption patterns (file accessible by both owner and recipient), the pattern is: wrap file key with owner pubkey in FilePointer.fileKeyEncrypted, wrap IPNS private key with owner key in FilePointer.ipnsPrivateKeyEncrypted, store recipient-wrapped IPNS key in share_keys with keyType='file-ipns'

friction: PostgreSQL host IP changed mid-session (192.168.133.114 → 192.168.133.12), requiring .env creation from scratch
Background dev server tasks killed repeatedly by Claude Code's background task cleanup — required switching to detached nohup processes
ci-debug checkout had no .env files at all, requiring discovery and copy from sibling repo
NestJS watch mode silently failing to pick up DTO changes required multiple restart cycles before OpenAPI spec updated
Git lock file present during commit attempts, requiring manual removal

Four separate UAT bug cycles discovered gaps that should have been caught during plan implementation: empty fileMetaIpnsName, wrong IPNS key wrapping party, wrong save path, missing re-wrap on owner edit
open_items: Files uploaded to shared folders before the IPNS fix are permanently inaccessible (empty fileMetaIpnsName) — no migration path exists for legacy shared-upload files
Owner edit re-wrapping (reWrapForRecipients) was added reactively — should audit all file mutation paths (rename metadata update, etc.) to ensure share_keys stay in sync
The 'file-ipns' share_key type is a new pattern — document the dual-key wrapping convention so future file operations know to handle it
E2E tests written but not run against the live stack — need CI run to confirm selectors and wait conditions are correct
Silent revocation (403 → [RW] to [RO] transition, IPNS key zeroing) was listed as a human verification item but not explicitly confirmed tested during UAT
30-second sync polling behavior was not explicitly verified during UAT session
